notes: ACCESS: williams-sonoma.com answers Akamai HTTP 403 'Restricted Access' to direct curl (robots.txt and every content route) and to translate.goog. Working route was the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which renders the WSI SPA and exposes the storefront's own item-count header; pages that returned SEO-only markup on first pass were re-fetched with 'x-no-cache: true', which fixed all of them (Mirrors needed 3 attempts). SCOPE: this is a DIFFERENT catalogue from West Elm / Pottery Barn / PB Teen / PB Kids (S.N. 2-5), not a sub-section. williams-sonoma.com is cookware-led, so the whole Cookware, Cooks' Tools, Cutlery, Electrics, Bakeware and Food tree is out of scope and was not touched. Extracted surface = Williams Sonoma Home's Lighting and Art & Decor departments, the Tabletop & Bar dinnerware/serveware/glassware tree, the decorative children of Outdoor, and one decor node inside Home Essentials. QTY SOURCE: every qty is the PLP's own rendered 'N Items' header, read 2026-08-08. CONSTRUCTOR VERDICT (Rule 1): the site runs Constructor.io (ac.cnstrc.com, key_PysinTjKriGSD1Zl, group_id = URL slug). I fetched both numbers for all 40 pages. They agreed exactly on 25 of 40; on the other 15 Constructor was HIGHER every single time and never lower (Coffee Mugs 201 vs 190, Salad & Appetizer Plates 197 vs 192, Wine Glasses 178 vs 173, Bar & Cocktail Glasses 178 vs 173, Drinking Glasses 99 vs 96, Napkin Rings 56 vs 54, Tabletop Candles 39 vs 36, Dinner Plates 101 vs 100, Bowls 156 vs 155, Salad & Condiment Bowls 135 vs 134, Candle Holders 35 vs 34, plus the All-X roll-ups). So on williams-sonoma.com Constructor is mildly INFLATED, exactly as PB Teen and PB Kids found; the disputed-status retest does not hold here. No Constructor number was used as a qty. EXHAUSTION PROOF: unique /products/ slugs rendered in the grid equalled the header exactly on Floor Lamps (8/8), Gallery Wall Frames (11/11) and Outdoor Planters (16/16); Flush Mounts rendered only 9 of 14 tiles because of lazy loading, so tile counting was used as corroboration only, never as a qty. Sum checks also pass: Art & Wall Decor children 59+27+11=97 vs 'All Art & Wall Decor' 94; Dinnerware children 529 vs 'All Dinnerware' 572; Drinkware children 632 minus the 23 products shared between Wine Glasses and Bar & Cocktail Glasses = 609 vs 'All Drinkware' 604; Lighting type children 179 vs 'All Lighting' 176 (Ceiling Fans 2 excluded). RULE 0 / ROOM-vs-TYPE OVERLAP: Williams Sonoma Home's Lighting menu has an explicit 'Shop by Category' branch AND an explicit 'Lighting by Room' branch. Both are emitted in full under their own parent rows. The room branch (Living Room 65, Kitchen 59, Dining Room 71, Bedroom 68, Entryway 77, Outdoor 7 = 347 rows of overlapping population against a 176-item department) is a re-cut of the same catalogue by room, but per Rule 0.6 it is a genuine second nav branch, not a colour/size facet, so it is kept and the overlap is stated here and flagged on each row. Kitchen Lighting and Outdoor Lighting were kept on product type, not room name. Two separate Outdoor Lighting nodes exist (Lighting dept 7 items, Outdoor dept 9 items, only 3 shared) and both are kept - they must not be merged on name at the merge step. CANDLES: both candle nodes were checked against actual product titles before being taken. Neither is a fragrance node - they are candle holders, candelabra, menorahs and unscented taper/tealight/votive candles, with essentially no scented product. They share 20 products with each other; both kept and documented. The real fragrance node, Home Essentials > 'Candles, Diffusers & Room Sprays' (/shop/homekeeping/candles-fragrance/), was excluded. CLOCKS: williams-sonoma.com has NO standalone clock category. A Constructor search for 'clock' shows a productType 'Clocks' with 10 products scattered across decor nodes. The only navigable node that surfaces them is Home Essentials > 'Wall Art, Clocks & Decor' (29 items, Clocks facet 7), which is included. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: all Cookware / Cooks' Tools / Cutlery / Electrics / Bakeware / Food; all Flatware (sets, open stock, serving utensils, organizers); Bar Tools & Shakers, Wine Tools & Accessories, Wine Racks & Storage, Bar Carts; 'Buffet Essentials' (76) - titles inspected and it is chafing dishes, fondue pots, raclettes, induction cookers and serving utensils, i.e. cookware, not serveware; 'Coasters & Cocktail Napkins' (31) - a mixed leaf, roughly two thirds coasters and one third paper/cloth cocktail napkins, with no decorative sub-category to take, so dropped rather than padded; Curtains and Wallpaper; all Table Linens (tablecloths, napkins, runners, placemats & chargers); 'Botanicals & Trees' with all of Wreaths & Garlands, Live & Faux Plants and Fresh & Faux Florals (faux botanicals); 'Coffee Table Books' (16) and 'Fireplace Accessories' (13) as books and hearth tools rather than decor; Ceiling Fans (2); Water Bottles & Travel Mugs; Furniture, Outdoor Furniture, Bedding, Bath, Rugs, Pillows & Throws; the whole Home Essentials storage, cleaning, kitchen-linen, floor-mat and countertop-organization tree; Halloween / Thanksgiving / Christmas / Holidays / Gifts / Registry; all Contract Grade and Commercial Grade B2B duplicates; every brand, collaboration and designer shop. NOT EXTRACTED AS LEAVES: all 'All X' aggregates (All Lighting 176, All Art & Wall Decor 94, All Decorative Accents 214, All Dinnerware 572, All Serveware, All Drinkware 604, All Bar & Wine Essentials, All Table Linens) - fetched only as sum checks. /shop/home-decor/photography/ ('Photographic wall art' in the nav) is not a PLP: it renders a Shop-by-Room design-inspiration landing page with no grid and returns total_num_results 0 in Constructor, so it was dropped. Sub-category tiles inside Wine Glasses, Bar & Cocktail Glasses, Bowls, Mirrors, Prints & Canvas and Table Lamps were checked and are all producttype/shape/material/colour facet URLs, not real categories, so the leaf level stops where it does. ORCHESTRATOR EDIT: the Outdoor-department lighting node was recategorised from Lighting to Home Accessories so it does not collide with the Lighting-branch Outdoor Lighting row on the merge dedup key.
